create_homogeneous_points: create a function that converts D-dimensional points to homogeneous coordinates by appending a trailing 1
convert_from_homogeneous: convert homogeneous coordinate points back to D-dimensional by normalizing with the last dimension value
interpolate_image_at_points: interpolate an image at specified (x, y) coordinates using bilinear or nearest neighbor method
map_neighborhood_function: apply a custom function to a pixel neighborhood slice centered on a given image coordinate
map_coordinates_interpolation: map an input image array to new coordinates via bilinear or nearest interpolation
